bookTitle: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis

facts.statement: Price and volume are the only two leading indicators in technical trading. In isolation both are weak, but combined they act like gunpowder, providing an explosive combination that allows traders to anticipate market direction before moves occur.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: There are only two leading indicators in trading. One is price, the other is volume. In isolation, they are weak and reveal little, but put them together, and just like gunpowder, they become an explosive combination.

facts.statement: Because spot foreign exchange lacks centralized volume reporting, tick volume measuring the frequency of price changes serves as a reliable proxy, with empirical studies confirming tick data is approximately 90% representative of true market order flow activity.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Because spot forex lacks centralized volume reporting, tick volume (measuring the frequency of price changes) serves as a proxy. Studies confirm tick data is approximately 90% representative of true market activity.

facts.statement: Volume bars can never be analyzed as isolated absolute figures. Every volume reading must be evaluated relative to preceding volume bars within the same chart timeframe to determine whether current market activity is low, average, high, or ultra-high.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: A volume bar cannot be analyzed in isolation. It must always be judged relative to preceding volume bars in the same timeframe to evaluate whether activity is low, average, high, or ultra-high.

facts.statement: Coulling compares trading to a live auction: low volume resembles a quiet rainy day where an item sells on a single bid with minimal price change, while high volume resembles a packed summer auction where aggressive bidding drives rapid price ticks.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Low Volume Scenario: A cold, winter day in a small provincial auction room... High Volume Scenario: The same item offered on a sunny summer day in a packed capital city auction house.

facts.statement: Demonstrating market pressure, water flowing freely through an open hosepipe exits with low force. Partially closing the sprinkler valve reduces the aperture, forcing the same volume through a smaller opening to create higher pressure and velocity.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Water flowing through an open hosepipe exits with low force. Partially closing the sprinkler valve reduces the aperture; the same volume of water forced through a smaller opening over time creates significantly higher pressure.

facts.statement: In the Parable of Uncle Joe, widgets have fixed circulating supply. To generate profits, Uncle Joe acts as a wholesaler: he spreads rumors of shortages to raise prices and distribute inventory at retail rates, then induces panic to buy back stock at wholesale.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Uncle Joe owns Widgets & Co., the state's sole licensed distributor... Their primary objective is acquiring inventory at wholesale price levels and clearing shelves by selling to the public at retail price levels.

facts.statement: Financial market specialists and market makers operate as licensed wholesale merchants whose core objective is accumulating stock inventory during public panics at wholesale prices and distributing that inventory during public euphoria at retail prices.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Financial market specialists act as licensed wholesale merchants whose primary goal is buying inventory at wholesale price levels and selling it at retail price levels.

facts.statement: Market makers hold a distinct structural advantage over retail participants because they observe both sides of the order book simultaneously, giving them total visibility into aggregate supply and demand across all market participants.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Market makers hold a unique structural advantage because they see both sides of the order book (total supply and demand across all buyers and sellers).

facts.statement: While specialists can manipulate price quotes, news events, and rumors to deceive retail traders, they can never hide volume. Volume acts as the ultimate unconcealable footprint revealing true accumulation and distribution campaigns.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: While specialists can manipulate prices using news and rumors, they cannot hide volume. Volume reveals whether specialists are accumulating (buying) or distributing (selling).

facts.statement: Richard Ney's laws state that specialists expect to sell retail what they bought wholesale, accumulate capital for larger cycles, leverage mass media for inventory transfers, and engineer price declines of increasing dimensions to shake out stubborn holders.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Specialists operate as merchants who expect to sell at retail what they purchased at wholesale... to acquire massive inventory, specialists induce price declines of increasing scale to shake out holdings.

facts.statement: Market makers exploit two primary psychological levers using media news: Fear of Loss to trigger panic selling during accumulation phases, and Greed / Fear of Missing Out (FOMO) to encourage retail buying during distribution phases.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Market makers manipulate trader psychology rather than the underlying assets, operating through two primary levers: Fear of Loss... and Greed / Fear of Missing Out (FOMO).

facts.statement: Accumulation requires repeatedly pushing prices up and down on minor news items to shake stubborn retail holders out of their positions, acting similarly to shaking olives or fruit from a tree until all crop drops into waiting baskets.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Accumulation requires repeatedly pushing prices up and down on minor news items to shake stubborn holders out of their positions, similar to shaking olives or fruit from a tree until all crop drops.

facts.statement: On November 22, 1963, following President Kennedy's assassination, the AT&T specialist dropped the stock from $138 to $130 to absorb panic selling, closed the exchange early, and reopened on November 25 at $140, capturing a $25,000 profit.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: The specialist in Telephone dropped the stock price from $138 to $130 on November 22, accumulated large inventories from panic sellers... and reopened the stock at $140, capturing a $25,000 profit.

facts.statement: When major economic releases (like NFP) drive price spikes, traders must inspect volume: a price jump on low volume indicates a stop-hunting trap by insiders, whereas a price spike accompanied by high and rising volume confirms genuine participation.

sourceCitation.book: A Complete Guide To Volume Price Analysis
sourceCitation.excerpt: Anomaly (Trap Move): If price jumps violently on news but associated volume remains low... Validation (Genuine Move): If a news-driven price spike is accompanied by high and rising volume, it confirms major operators are participating.

generalAssumptions: Market price manipulation is structurally transparent on the volume tape.
Effort versus result governs institutional capital movement.
